project.name: Waka distribution
project.description:
Packaging only. This module has no src directory and never will: it holds the jlink and jpackage steps (S01-T27 and T28) and later the Inno Setup script (S06), and its packaging is pom so that no jar is produced for it.
The dependency on waka-app below is not there to be compiled against - nothing here compiles. It is what tells Maven the reactor order is core, then app, then dist, and it is how the packaging steps find the application jar to put in the image.
